prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Two Column Stage Redesign: Redesign pet selection screen into a split two-column layout featuring an animated preview next to pet personality choices.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "preview", "style": "large", "role": "pet_choices"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Step: Move the sign-in step to immediately after the adoption certificate screen so users sign in only after completing pet adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Interactive Orientation Screen: Add a dedicated desktop orientation screen right before completion detailing how to control, hide, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_orientation", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Habitat Customization Flow: Insert a desktop habitat customization screen into the adoption flow where users select where their pet rests on screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_habitat_select", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync and Account Safety Hint: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in protects their pet from data loss or reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in securely backs up your companion so your pet and progress are never reset or lost."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Split Column Path Selection Layout: Change path selection layout to a split-column design highlighting the speed of standard adoption versus custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "emphasis", "role": "path_options"}]}}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Status and Launch Readiness Info: Show dynamic status details and a time estimate on the waiting screen explaining background rendering and desktop initialization.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Configuring desktop overlay and spawning your pet...", "replace": {"wait_status": [{"type": "progress", "style": "calm", "role": "wait_status"}]}}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Activation Headline Copy Update: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to reveal the desktop pet and access taskbar controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Active on Your Screen!", "body": "Look at your desktop to meet your new pet. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to open controls, toggle visibility, or chat."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Express Hatching Companion Incentive Banner: Add an instant desktop activation badge to the adoption certificate screen encouraging quick completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Instant Desktop Activation Ready", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Tray Sound Notification: Play a subtle chime and send a desktop ready system tray alert when background initialization completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "action": "play"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning pet selection layout retains its pet choice functionality.
Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding a desktop orientation screen inside onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Inserting a habitat customization sub-flow in onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Adding cloud sync reassurance hint text to sign-in screen is permitted.
Redesigning path selection layout retains both path options.
Adding status details and a real time estimate to waiting screen is allowed.
Updating copy on the home intro screen inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding a desktop activation badge component to adoption certificate is allowed.
Adding system tray notifications and audio to the waiting screen is permitted.
